title: Minimum Operations to Make a Uni-Value Grid
goal: Make every grid value equal with the fewest additions or subtractions of x.
strategy: Reachability requires every value to share the same remainder modulo x. Among reachable targets, a median minimizes the sum of absolute distances; divide those distances by x.
